arg.name: points
arg.description: The point cloud of a 3D LiDAR (sensor_msgs/PointCloud2), e.g. /livox/lidar of livox_ros_driver2 (xfer_format 0).

arg.name: scan
arg.description: The scan of a 2D LiDAR (sensor_msgs/LaserScan), with input_type scan.

arg.name: input_type
arg.description: Type of input: points (PointCloud2 of a 3D LiDAR, e.g. Livox) or scan (LaserScan of a 2D LiDAR).

arg.name: voxel_size
arg.description: Size (m) of the voxels of the map, e.g. 0.5 outdoors and 0.1 - 0.2 indoors.

arg.name: max_points_per_voxel
arg.description: Maximum points in a voxel of the map.

arg.name: min_range
arg.description: Minimum range (m) of the points, without the robot.

arg.name: max_range
arg.description: Maximum range (m) of the points, and of the map.

arg.name: max_iterations
arg.description: Maximum iterations of ICP of each scan.

arg.name: correspondence_distance
arg.description: Maximum distance (m) of the corresponding points of the scan and the map, larger than the error of the initial guess of the constant velocity.

arg.name: odom_frame
arg.description: Frame of the odometry, the robot (base_frame) at the start.

arg.name: base_frame
arg.description: Frame of the robot, whose TF to the sensor is given (e.g. base_link, base_footprint), or empty for the frame of the sensor.

arg.name: publish_tf
arg.description: Publish the TF odom_frame -> base_frame; with it at the start, the node subscribes the inputs always, for the subscribers of /tf.

arg.name: path_length
arg.description: Number of the poses of ~/path, the trajectory for rviz, 0 for all of them.
